items.html: You find that when Hassadim and Gevurot expand below in the Guf of ZA, the Hassadim are given to ZA and in that complete and finish the construction of its posterior entirely. Also, the Gevurot are given to the Nukva, and thus complete her posterior. Thus, he has complete posterior, and she has complete posterior, and then, they can return to face-to-face since their posterior are complete, and now the external ones cannot grip there. Conversely, in the beginning, when one had half the posterior and the other had half, they could have a grip on them. For this reason, they can now return to face-to-face, as there is no fear of the external ones, as we say in the explanation of the intention in the blessing of the patriarchs of the Amida [prayer] during weekdays, and examine that closely. You find that the benefit from the entry of the Hassadim and the Gevurot in ZA was for two reasons, which are one: They enlarge and complete the posterior of ZON, and in addition, by this, they return to face-to-face.
